title: THE SHOP FILLS ITS WINDOW
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): make the menus look like a AAA game, checked in pictures. In the shop the item grid and the detail card stopped at about 60 percent of the window height, so the lower part of the window was empty. Both now run down to the footer, the price, amount and BUY sit together at the foot of the card, and the tiles are a little larger.
now: The shop grid and card fill the window, with BUY at the foot of the card.
